name: Havi
source:
An intrepid traveler always on the lookout for new, rare flowers, he's easy-going and enjoys Yarrow's company. He's been back to visit Yarrow's planet multiple times.

Likes: Unique plants and flowers, new planets
Dislikes: Toxic air, his friends getting hurt

[From [url=https://arcadeparty.itch.io/yarrow-valley]itch.io[/url]]
